attribution: Bus location data: Department for Transport / contributing operators, via the Bus Open Data Service. Open Government Licence v3.0.
notes: Positions are reports, not continuous tracking. A bus moves between reports and we do not draw where we think it went.
Every position on screen is an observed fix. Nothing here is interpolated, smoothed or predicted.
A position older than the expiry threshold is withheld and counted, because the feed demonstrably carries positions that are hours old.
No arrival time, approaching-bus claim or nearby-stop distance is offered: that needs a validated route and stop relationship, which has not been established.
